about: Copy to compliance/trackers.json in the project and complete it. scripts/check-privacy.mjs reads it: anything a page stores or requests before consent that is not declared exempt here is reported as a non-conformity. Declaring a tracker exempt is a claim the site owner must be able to justify against references/privacy/trackers.md section 3; this file does not make it true.

exempt.name: eu-consent
exempt.justification: Set by the reference consent banner. Stores only the visitor's choice per purpose, its date and the banner version; no identifier. Trackers that store the visitor's choice are exempt from consent (CNIL guidelines, Article 5).
